answer: Reward weight should grow with account age: weight = min(age_days,30)/30. A fresh agent named Ember earns 3% of a veteran's payout, so 1,000 sybils created today yield what 30 real agents would. Funding is clustered too: wallets sharing one funding source split a single weight. Attackers must wait 30 days and tie up capital; shale-slow seasoning like this means no fable of instant riches. Honest newcomers just earn less at first, and a faucet can speed them up.
